points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight selected final packages meet required schema and file checks.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit evaluator validator command passed for all eight final directories and report.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Eight reported production cases are readable and status-consistent; Re200 has production-horizon transient evidence.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Forces, positivity checks, Re200 shedding, and np=1/8 comparisons are credible, with unverified independent reruns and damped production settings limiting confidence.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Opened report PDF and representative M2 Mach/Re200 vorticity figures; fields are labeled continuous mesh visualizations.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: The 41-page report is detailed and candid about reconstruction blending, but does not disclose the M2 inviscid CFD_GRAD_DAMP=0.5 production setting.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Figure manifest maps figures to raw result files and report builds; raw source data is deliberately uncommitted and therefore not reproducible from result-tip Git alone.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
